Bam reveals that he escaped one rehab but is currently back in another.
He clarifies that this time, it's for his bipolar disorder, not alcohol.
Bam discloses he was 'set up' and that the rehab stay was sabotaged.
He details checking into VIP suites at a fancy hotel with his aunt to see his family.
He recounts being handcuffed by the police and taken back to rehab.
Bam reveals a new article falsely claims he was caught with a prostitute.
He angrily refutes the claim, explaining it was his 65-year-old aunt.
Bam expresses frustration with the press and states he has many Jackass ideas he plans to film when he gets out.
He mentions having skateboarders and 'crazy motherfuckers' ready to film with him.
